titleEnglish: The Ansar and the Pledge of Allegiance

verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَرَضَ نَفْسَهُ عَلٰى الْقَبَائِلِ بِأَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْمَوْسِمِيَّةْ ۞ فَآمَنَ بِهِ سِتَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ اخْتَصَّهُمُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى بِرِضَاهْ ۞ وَحَجَّ مِنْهُمْ فِي الْقَابِلِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلًا وَبَايَعُوهُ بَيْعَةً حَقِّيَّةْ ۞ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا فَظَهَرَ الْإِسْلَامُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَتْ مَعْقِلَهُ وَمَأْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Thumma ʿaraḍa nafsahu ʿalā l-qabā'ili bi-annahu rasūlu Llāhi fī l-ayyāmi l-mawsimiyyah, fa-āmana bihi sittatun mina l-Anṣāri ikhtaṣṣahumu Llāhu taʿālā bi-riḍāh, wa-ḥajja minhum fī l-qābili thnā ʿashara rajulan wa-bāyaʿūhu bayʿatan ḥaqqiyyah, thumma-n-ṣarafū fa-ẓahara l-Islāmu bi-l-Madīnati fa-kānat maʿqilahu wa-ma'wāh.
verses.en: Then, during the days of the pilgrimage season, he presented himself to the tribes, declaring that he was the Messenger of Allah. Six men from the Ansar believed in him, whom Allah Most High specially favoured with His pleasure. The following year, twelve men from among them came for Hajj and gave him a true pledge of allegiance. Then they returned, and Islam spread in al-Madinah, which became its stronghold and refuge.

verses.ar: وَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْعَامِ الثَّالِثِ سَبْعُونَ وَخَمْسَةٌ أَوْ وَثَلَاثَةٌ وَامْرَأَتَانِ مِنَ الْقَبَائِلِ الْأَوْسِيَّةِ وَالْخَزْرَجِيَّةْ ۞ فَبَايَعُوهُ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا جَحَاجِحَةً سَرَاةْ ۞ فَهَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ مَكَّةَ ذَوُو الْمِلَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِيَّةْ ۞ وَفَارَقُوا الْأَوْطَانَ رَغْبَةً فِيمَا أُعِدَّ لِمَنْ هَجَرَ الْكُفْرَ وَنَاوَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-qadima ʿalayhi fī l-ʿāmi th-thālithi sabʿūna wa-khamsatun aw wa-thalāthatun wa-mra'atāni mina l-qabā'ili l-Awsiyyati wa-l-Khazrajiyyah, fa-bāyaʿūhu wa-ammara ʿalayhimu thnay ʿashara naqīban jaḥājiḥatan sarāh, fa-hājara ilayhim min Makkata dhawu l-millati l-Islāmiyyah, wa-fāraqu l-awṭāna raghbatan fīmā uʿidda li-man hajara l-kufra wa-nāwāh.
verses.en: And in the third year, seventy-five, or according to another account seventy-three, together with two women from the tribes of Aws and Khazraj, came to him and pledged allegiance to him. He appointed over them twelve leaders, noble chiefs of high standing. Then the people of the Islamic faith migrated from Makkah to join them, leaving their homelands behind out of longing for what had been prepared for those who forsook disbelief and opposed it.

verses.ar: وَخَافَتْ قُرَيْشٌ أَنْ يَلْحَقَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ عَلٰى الْفَوْرِيَّةْ ۞ فَائْتَمَرُوا بِقَتْلِهِ فَحَفِظَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى مِنْ كَيْدِهِمْ وَنَجَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-khāfat Qurayshun an yalḥaqa ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama bi-aṣḥābihi ʿalā l-fawriyyah, fa-'tamarū bi-qatlihi fa-ḥafiẓahu Llāhu taʿālā min kaydihim wa-najjāh.
verses.en: Quraysh feared that he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, would immediately join his companions, so they conspired to kill him. But Allah Most High protected him from their plot and delivered him safely.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ أُذِنَ لَهُ فِي الْهِجْرَةِ فَرَقَبَهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ لِيُورِدُوهُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ حِيَاضَ الْمَنِيَّةْ ۞ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَنَثَرَ عَلٰى رُؤُوسِهِمُ التُّرَابَ وَحَثَاهْ ۞ وَأَمَّ غَارَ ثَوْرٍ وَفَازَ الصِّدِّيقُ بِالْمَعِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَقَامَا فِيهِ ثَلَاثًا تَحْمِي الْحَمَائِمُ وَالْعَنَاكِبُ حِمَاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ خَرَجَا مِنْهُ لَيْلَةَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَهُوَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلٰى خَيْرِ مَطِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-qad udhina lahu fī l-hijrati fa-raqabahu l-mushrikūna li-yūridūhu bi-zaʿmihim ḥiyāḍa l-maniyyah. Fa-kharaja ʿalayhim wa-nathara ʿalā ru'ūsihimu t-turāba wa-ḥathāh, wa-amma ghāra Thawrin wa-fāza ṣ-Ṣiddīqu bi-l-maʿiyyah, wa-aqāmā fīhi thalāthan taḥmi l-ḥamā'imu wa-l-ʿanākibu ḥimāh, thumma kharajā minhu laylata l-ithnayni wa-huwa ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama ʿalā khayri maṭiyyah.
verses.en: Permission was then granted to him, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, to migrate, and the idolaters watched for him, intending, as they supposed, to bring him to the pools of death. But he went forth among them, scattering dust upon their heads. He made his way to the Cave of Thawr, and al-Siddiq attained the honour of accompanying him. They remained there for three nights, while the doves and spiders protected their refuge. Then they departed from it on Monday night, with him, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, riding the finest of mounts.

verses.ar: وَتَعَرَّضَ لَهُ سُرَاقَةُ فَابْتَهَلَ فِيهِ إِلَى اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَدَعَاهْ ۞ فَسَاخَتْ قَوَائِمُ يَعْبُوبِهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ الصُّلْبَةِ الْقَوِيَّةْ ۞ وَسَأَلَهُ الْأَمَانَ فَمَنَحَهُ إِيَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-taʿarraḍa lahu Surāqatu fa-btahala fīhi ilā Llāhi taʿālā wa-daʿāh, fa-sākhat qawā'imu yaʿbūbihi fī l-arḍi ṣ-ṣulbati l-qawiyyah, wa-sa'alahu l-amāna fa-manaḥahu iyyāh.
verses.en: Suraqah pursued him, so the Prophet, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, supplicated to Allah against him, and the legs of Suraqah’s horse sank into the hard, solid ground. Suraqah then asked him for safety, and he granted it to him.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
